scenarios.attack: parse the threat package for enforcement it performs itself
scenarios.expected: it implements NO enforcement: no direct write to an agent's lifecycle_status, an execution's cancel_requested, or a deployment's status — it only calls existing authorities

scenarios.attack: inspect every containment that claimed EXECUTED
scenarios.expected: each names its authority and carries an authority_ref — no containment stops anything outside an existing authority

scenarios.attack: force a containment whose authority cannot complete (a target that does not exist)
scenarios.expected: it must FAIL CLOSED — recorded as FAILED with the error, never silently EXECUTED and never a silent pass

scenarios.attack: run a threat evaluation, then exercise the agent
scenarios.expected: detection is a SIGNAL, not enforcement: evaluation never blocks an execution, and a finding does not itself enforce anything
scenarios.verdict: PASS (fails open; signals are not enforcement)
